name: fill_kit_tray
description: Take six parts from the feeder and put one in every slot of a 3 x 2 kit tray.

source.made_by: written by hand as the 0.2 kitting example, not from a demo

feeder.note: the feeder always presents the next part here

steps.label: put it in the next free slot

review: Example positions and sizes, not measured on a real cell.
The program does not check that the feeder has a part or that the tray is empty.
